errors.noSuchVersion: no such version of this model

subBaseline: Version {version} of @{owner}’s {model}, entered in {game} {season}. A platform baseline: it plays and is rated like any entry, and new versions’ trials are played against it.

waiting.title: Waiting for its trial.
waiting.admitted: Admitted {date}. It replaces the playing version only if the trial completes below the strike limit — it does not have to win.
waiting.queued: Admitted {date} and queued against a baseline on {map}. It replaces the playing version only if the trial completes below the strike limit — it does not have to win.
waiting.waited: Admitted {date} and queued against a baseline on {map}. It has waited {waited}. It replaces the playing version only if the trial completes below the strike limit — it does not have to win.

rejected.title: Rejected at admission.
rejected.noReason: Admission refused it and did not record a reason. That is a fault on our side, not a fact about your model.

testing.title: In admission.
testing.body: We are fetching the files, checking them against the hashes you declared, and measuring the model and manifest into a weight class.
testing.bodyAttempt: We are fetching the files, checking them against the hashes you declared, and measuring the model and manifest into a weight class. This is attempt {attempt}.

superseded.title: Replaced by v{version}.
superseded.body: It played and has been replaced. Its rating is where it finished.

matches.title: Matches
matches.emptyUnplayed: It has not played. A version starts playing once it passes its trial.

record.title: Record
record.artifactHint: the key generated from the version id — it cannot be retagged or deleted, which is what makes the hash mean something later

phases.active: It passed its trial and is the version that plays for this model.
phases.superseded: It passed its trial, played, and has since been replaced by a newer version.
phases.verified: Admitted and measured. The trial is the last step before it replaces the playing version.
phases.testing: Submitted. Admission is fetching the files and measuring them.
phases.rejected: It was refused at admission, so it never reached a trial and never played.
